hoenn_birch_intro: Professor Birch: Hey there! You must be the new trainer!
I need your help! My Pokémon got loose on Route 101!
Choose your starter: Treecko, Torchic, or Mudkip!
hoenn_birch_starter: Professor Birch: Excellent choice! Here's your Pokédex and 5 Poké Balls!
hoenn_may_brendan_rival: Rival: Hey! Let's see who's the better trainer!
I'll be waiting for you at the next gym!
hoenn_norman_intro: Norman: Welcome to the Petalburg Gym! I'm your father... and the Normal-type Gym Leader!
hoenn_roxanne_intro: Roxanne: Welcome to Rustboro City Gym! I'm Roxanne, the Rock-type Gym Leader.
hoenn_team_magma_aqua_intro: Team Magma/Team Aqua Grunt: The boss is planning something big at Mt. Chimney!
hoenn_steven_stone_gift: Steven: Here, take this Steel Wing. It will help you in battle.
hoenn_wallace_intro: Wallace: The sea is calling... Are you ready for the final challenge?
hoenn_elite_four: Congratulations! You've reached the Pokémon League!
hoenn_legendary_awakening: The ground shakes... Groudon/Kyogre has awakened!
hoenn_newgame_intro: The moving truck rumbles to a stop in Littleroot Town.
Mom: Here we are, {player_name}! Our new home in the Hoenn region!
Mom: Professor Birch lives just next door. Why don't you go say hello?
hoenn_mom_newstart_1: Mom: The movers finally left! Most of the boxes are still packed, though.
Mom: Your father's Gym is in Petalburg City. He'd love to see how you're doing!
hoenn_mom_newstart_2: Mom: Littleroot is so peaceful. I can hear Wingull out by the shore.
Mom: Remember, if you win prize money, I'll keep it safe for you. Every Poké Dollar counts!
hoenn_mom_newstart_3: Mom: I put a little savings jar on the counter for your battle winnings.
Mom: If it ever fills up, maybe we'll buy a vacation house somewhere. Ha ha!
hoenn_mom_home_1: Mom: {player_name}! Welcome to our new Littleroot home!
Mom: The prize money you sent from your last League paid for the moving truck AND the house.
Mom: The neighbors think I won the lottery. I told them my kid is just really good at math.
hoenn_mom_home_2: Mom: I've been learning to cook Hoenn style. Today it's Lava Cookies from Lavaridge!
Mom: Owning a house in every region you conquer is turning into quite the hobby.
hoenn_mom_home_3: Mom: The weather here changes so fast! Sunny one minute, pouring rain the next.
Mom: Professor Birch says it has to do with two ancient Pokémon. Isn't that exciting?
hoenn_birch_lab: Aide: The Professor is out doing fieldwork on Route 101 again.
Aide: He says the best research happens in the tall grass, not behind a desk!
hoenn_rival_intro: {rival_name}: So you're the new kid who moved in next door!
{rival_name}: My dad is Professor Birch. Let's see what your Pokémon can do!
hoenn_rival_won: {rival_name}: Wow, you're good! No wonder Dad trusted you with a Pokémon.
hoenn_rival_lost: {rival_name}: Ha! Practice your math and try again!

intro: I'm practicing for my first gym battle!
Have you seen Professor Birch?
My bugs are small but fast!
Let's see how much you've grown!
player_lost: You still have a long way to go!

intro: Hand over the goods and the bird!
The power of the volcano is mine!
The super-ancient Pokémon will wake!
I've come this far with my Pokémon!
Grunt: Hand over those Devon Goods, kid!
player_lost: Grunt: Ha! The Goods are ours!

intro: Grunt: Captain Stern's submarine plans belong to Team Aqua!
player_won: Grunt: We have to tell the boss...

intro: Archie: The sea is the source of all life! Expanding it is our duty!
Archie: A kid like you can't understand our grand plan!
player_won: Archie: Hmph. Team Aqua, fall back! This isn't over!
Captain Stern: Thank you! Please, take this Super Rod as thanks.

intro: Grunt: The rocket fuel is ours! Stand aside!
Tabitha: Hehehe! With this fuel, Mt. Chimney will erupt!
player_won: Tabitha: Leader Maxie won't be happy...

Maxie: You will not interfere a second time!
player_won: Maxie: ...Perhaps I have miscalculated. Team Magma, withdraw!
Scientist: You saved the launch! The rocket will fly on schedule!
player_lost: Maxie: Land is the future. Remember that.

intro: Grunt: How did you find our hideout?!
Grunt: The submarine already left! You're too late!
Matt: Hoohahah! The boss is already on his way to the Seafloor Cavern!

player_won: Matt: Hoo! You're strong! Fine, take this... the boss won't miss it.

JOURNAL_MISSIONS.title: Birch's Rescue
JOURNAL_MISSIONS.description: Professor Birch is in trouble on Route 101! Help him and choose your starter Pokémon (Treecko, Torchic, or Mudkip).

JOURNAL_MISSIONS.title: Rival Showdown
JOURNAL_MISSIONS.description: Your rival (May or Brendan) wants to test your new Pokémon on Route 103.

JOURNAL_MISSIONS.title: Stone Badge
JOURNAL_MISSIONS.description: Defeat Roxanne at the Rustboro City Gym to earn the Stone Badge.

JOURNAL_MISSIONS.title: Devon Goods Recovery
JOURNAL_MISSIONS.description: Team Magma/Aqua stole the Devon Goods! Retrieve them from the thief in Rusturf Tunnel.

JOURNAL_MISSIONS.title: Knuckle Badge
JOURNAL_MISSIONS.description: Defeat Brawly at the Dewford Town Gym and meet Steven Stone in Granite Cave.

JOURNAL_MISSIONS.title: Slateport Team Incident
JOURNAL_MISSIONS.description: Investigate the suspicious activity at the Oceanic Museum in Slateport City.

JOURNAL_MISSIONS.title: Dynamo Badge
JOURNAL_MISSIONS.description: Defeat Wattson at the Mauville City Gym.

JOURNAL_MISSIONS.title: Wally's Training
JOURNAL_MISSIONS.description: Help Wally catch his first Pokémon in Verdanturf Town and witness his growth.

JOURNAL_MISSIONS.title: Heat Badge
JOURNAL_MISSIONS.description: Defeat Flannery at the Lavaridge Town Gym after the Mt. Chimney events.

JOURNAL_MISSIONS.title: Mt. Chimney Crisis
JOURNAL_MISSIONS.description: Stop Team Magma/Aqua from awakening Groudon/Kyogre at Mt. Chimney.

JOURNAL_MISSIONS.title: Feather Badge
JOURNAL_MISSIONS.description: Defeat Winona at the Fortree City Gym and clear the Weather Institute.

JOURNAL_MISSIONS.title: Weather Institute Rescue
JOURNAL_MISSIONS.description: Team Magma/Aqua has taken over the Weather Institute on Route 119. Stop them and obtain Castform.

JOURNAL_MISSIONS.title: Mind Badge
JOURNAL_MISSIONS.description: Defeat Tate & Liza at the Mossdeep City Gym.

JOURNAL_MISSIONS.title: Space Center Defense
JOURNAL_MISSIONS.description: Protect the Mossdeep Space Center from Team Magma/Aqua.

JOURNAL_MISSIONS.title: Rain Badge
JOURNAL_MISSIONS.description: Defeat Wallace at the Sootopolis City Gym.

JOURNAL_MISSIONS.title: Seafloor Cavern Showdown
JOURNAL_MISSIONS.description: Dive into Seafloor Cavern and stop the final Team Magma/Aqua plan to awaken the super-ancient Pokémon.

JOURNAL_MISSIONS.title: Cave of Origin
JOURNAL_MISSIONS.description: Enter the Cave of Origin in Sootopolis City to calm the awakened legendary Pokémon.

JOURNAL_MISSIONS.title: Sky Pillar Summit
JOURNAL_MISSIONS.description: Climb the Sky Pillar with Steven and awaken Rayquaza to stop the weather catastrophe.

JOURNAL_MISSIONS.title: Balance Badge
JOURNAL_MISSIONS.description: Return home and defeat your father Norman at the Petalburg Gym for the Balance Badge.

JOURNAL_MISSIONS.title: Conquer the League
JOURNAL_MISSIONS.description: Travel through Victory Road, defeat the Elite Four, and become the Hoenn Champion by defeating Wallace.

JOURNAL_MISSIONS.title: Wally Rematch
JOURNAL_MISSIONS.description: Face Wally one final time inside Victory Road.

JOURNAL_MISSIONS.title: Rusturf Tunnel Rescue
JOURNAL_MISSIONS.description: Help Mr. Briney rescue the kidnapped Wingull in Rusturf Tunnel and clear the path.

JOURNAL_MISSIONS.title: Steven's Gifts
JOURNAL_MISSIONS.description: Meet Steven Stone multiple times and receive the Steel Wing and other rare items.

JOURNAL_MISSIONS.title: Abandoned Ship Mystery
JOURNAL_MISSIONS.description: Explore the haunted Abandoned Ship on Route 108 and find the Scanner.

JOURNAL_MISSIONS.title: Shoal Cave Treasures
JOURNAL_MISSIONS.description: Collect Shoal Salt and Shoal Shells in Shoal Cave for the old man in Pacifidlog Town.

JOURNAL_MISSIONS.title: Safari Zone Adventure
JOURNAL_MISSIONS.description: Catch rare Pokémon in the Hoenn Safari Zone near Lilycove City.

JOURNAL_MISSIONS.title: Regi Trio Awakening
JOURNAL_MISSIONS.description: Solve the braille puzzles and awaken Regirock, Regice, and Registeel.

JOURNAL_MISSIONS.title: Contest Master
JOURNAL_MISSIONS.description: Participate in Pokémon Contests in Verdanturf, Fallarbor, Lilycove, and Slateport.
